slots.name: share purchase tax rate
slots.sentence: She wants the government to scrap the 0.5% tax, external Britons pay when they purchase UK shares, pointing out there is no tax when they buy foreign stocks.

slots.name: tax credit scheme end year
slots.sentence: She also supports the idea of tax credits for Britons investing domestically. The UK had such a scheme until 2016.
